evidence.title: Set up Vercel for your AI coding agent
Vercel Pricing: Hobby, Pro, and Enterprise plans

name: Vercel
summary: Cloud platform for building, deploying and scaling web apps and AI workloads, with templates, CLI, API and MCP.
description: Vercel deploys web applications, APIs and AI workloads from Git or the CLI, with preview deployments, a global CDN, observability and a REST API. Its agent stack adds AI SDK, AI Gateway for routing across model providers and Sandbox for untrusted code. Includes a template gallery, docs, knowledge base and an agent plugin with skills.
contains: Hobby free plan, Pro $20/mo, Enterprise custom
deploy from a Git repository or the Vercel CLI
AI SDK, AI Gateway with fallbacks and spend controls, Sandbox for untrusted code
REST API with OpenAPI description and an OAuth MCP server
template gallery filtered by use case, framework, CSS and database
Vercel plugin and skills for coding agents
docs, knowledge base, academy and changelog
